rule: Wallonia: circulaire photovoltaïque of 14 Mar 2024 (replaces 12 Jan 2022): farmland must keep its food function; ground PV on farmed parcels only as research pilot projects compatible with farming. Flanders: policy note 'Zonneparken en agrivoltaïcs in agrarisch gebied' (farming stays primary; 6 projects advised negatively in 2025)
source: Wallonia: circular, UVCW (verified); Flanders: minister's answers via Solar Magazine (secondary)

rule: EEG §37(4): no tenders for ground PV on agricultural land above 80 GW operating, 177.5 GW after 31 Dec 2030; arable / grassland only in less-favoured areas (§37(1) Nr. 2 h, i) or as Agri-PV (Nr. 3)

No national limit on farmland; municipal planning plus state-designated energy parks (lov nr 614 of 11 Jun 2024); ambition of a market-driven quadrupling of land-based solar and wind by 2030 (aftale of 10 Oct 2025)

Code de l'urbanisme L.111-29 (loi APER 2023-175 art. 54): non-agrivoltaic solar on agricultural, natural or forest land only on surfaces of the departmental document-cadre (prefectoral order): land not farmable (R.111-56) or not farmed for >= 10 years before March 2023 (R.111-57), plus listed categories (R.111-58: brownfields, quarries, landfills...); agrivoltaics: yield > 90 % of a control plot (code de l'énergie R.314-114), coverage <= 40 % above 10 MWc for non-proven technologies (R.314-118); no area or capacity limit
Solar Roadmap 2025: 45-47 GW solar by 2030 on up to 0.4 % of UK land; best and most versatile land must be justified, lower-quality land preferred

No limit on farmland in law or guidance (no national solar planning guidelines, 2025); solar farms need full planning permission (farm exemption S.I. 493/2022 Class 18: <= 75 m2 free-standing); 8 GW solar by 2030 (CAP25)
source: irishstatutebook.ie (verified); CAP25 target via IEA (secondary, gov.ie unreachable)

rule: Agrivoltaic tenders on grassland and arable land (pilot 2022: 50 MW; 2025: 75 MWc, 100 kWc-5 MWc, an active farmer in each project)

Aangescherpte voorkeursvolgorde zon (Kamerstuk 32813 nr. 1310, 26 Oct 2023): solar on farmland and nature land 'in principe ongewenst'; exceptions only for agri-PV with a substantial farming function, land in transition under binding agreements, or projects that reduce grid congestion; binding through the provincial omgevingsverordeningen since early 2025 (Kamerstuk 32813 nr. 1464)

Jordlova §9: cultivated land not to be used for non-farming purposes except by dispensation; not applicable to plants with a concession (energiloven §3-1) or zoned in a reguleringsplan (§2); national goal <= 2,000 daa (200 ha) of cultivated land converted per year by 2030, all uses (~0.5 % of farmland to 2050); farmland ~3 % of the land
